programmes.d: The Doctor, Sarah and Scorby are hunted down by the mad Harrison Chase.
The TARDIS flies into the Mandragora Helix, an alien energy in space.
The Doctor is making enemies of the Court Astrologer Hieronymous.
Torture and death await the Doctor as the Powers of Darkness envelop the Earth.
The Doctor and his companions are trapped in the palace by members of the Cult of Demons.
Sarah finds a mysterious fossilized hand, which re-grows and begins to move.
The hand builds power and reacts to nuclear radiation, causing an overload situation.
The fossilized hand has regenerated into a Kastrian called Eldrad who appears to be female.
Eldrad reconfigures his body to its male form and states he will return to Earth to rule.
The Doctor returns to Gallifrey and races to prevent a tragedy.
The Time Lord president has been assassinated, and the Doctor is the prime suspect.
The Doctor enters the virtual world of the Matrix hoping to track down the Master.
The Master makes his final bid to release the devastating power of the Time Lords.
The Doctor arrives on an alien world and is accused of being 'the evil one'.
The Doctor tries to win the trust of the savage Sevateem tribe.
The Doctor discovers the terrible truth about Xoanon and realizes that he is to blame.
The insane computer Xoanon refuses the Doctor's help and prepares to destroy the planet.
The TARDIS takes the Doctor and Leela to a huge, mobile sand mine on an alien world.
The Doctor and Leela are blamed for the murder of one of the sandminer's crew.
Taren Capel is using the robots to carry out the murders.
As the robots close in, the Doctor and Leela join forces with the crew to fight back.

(1/4) The Doctor is infected by an alien virus and becomes possessed by the will of the Nucleus.
(2/4) As the Doctor's condition worsens, he tells Leela to take him to the Bi-Al Foundation.
(3/4) The Doctor and Leela have been cloned, miniaturized and injected into the Doctor's body.
(4/4) The Nucleus has escaped the Doctor's body and grown to human size.
The Doctor and Leela are on Fang Rock island where a murderous creature is at large.
A thick fog surrounds Fang Rock as an alien menace stalks the island.
The survivors are in the lighthouse, but the Doctor is still worried about the creature.
The alien Rutan begins to pick off the remaining humans one by one.
At Fetch Priory a mysterious skull is exerting a deadly influence on those around it.
The Doctor realizes the skull is an ancient horror from the mythology of his own people.
Stahl intends to control the power of the Fendahl for himself.

Thea has become the Fendahl Core and transforms everyone into Fendahleen.
The TARDIS arrives on a dystopian Pluto where a large company exploits its workers.
The Doctor is taken prisoner by the Gatherer and sent to the Correction Centre.
Leela has been captured by the Gatherer and is sentenced to death by public steaming.
The rebels turn on the Gatherer while the Doctor confronts the real head of the Company.
The Doctor encounters the survivors of Minyos, who are searching for a lost spacecraft.
The Minyans unexpectedly find the P7E spacecraft, but their arrival is not welcomed.
The Doctor and Leela attempt to access the Citadel of the Seers to rescue Idas's father.
The Doctor is suspicious when the Oracle allows Jackson to take the Minyan's gene banks.
The Doctor returns to Gallifrey to claim his position as President of the Time Lords.
The Doctor orders K9 to lower Gallifrey's defences.
The Doctor is accused of betrayal when the Vardans invade Gallifrey.
